items.title: fresh verifier for gate G2
items.task: Fresh verifier for gate G2 of this track (checklist item C17; decision 0016 item 4; coord/DECISIONS/0044 item 1). About ninety minutes, processors only. Trust nothing and do not read the lead's verdicts first (the outcome entries of g2long/JOURNAL.md, stage/REVIEW-wave3.md, the verdict column of stage/G2/CHECKLIST.md): take the criteria from the track's scope text (the null-test criterion N and the growth criterion G with their parts), the predictions as they were written before the runs (git log shows when), and what is claimed from stage/G2/EVIDENCE.md or STAGE_REPORT.md and the ledger of note v3 (its part 11). With readers of your own, not the package's scripts, recompute from the registered outputs: (1) the exact reference the criteria use (dust falling into a black hole: the crossing time of each shell at the horizon and the law of the mass growth): write your own and test it on a closed-form case first; (2) the null test: the drift of the horizon mass in vacuum on the meshes M/8 and M/16 against its bound, and the failure at M/4 (the lead: 2.28e-4, 1.99e-4, 4.57e-3); horizon numbers come from the finder's summaries, and no run of this track has status files: use the failure signature (a failed search writes NaN or a bit-identical repeat of the line before) and say 'made without the diagnostics'; (3) the growth criterion on the members FK (N), FN4 (4N), FNQ (N/4) and FL16 (mesh M/16) with their vacuum controls: the medians per bin, the part that must hold at every sample, the removed mass-energy against the horizon's growth, the mass at the end; (4) the three-way convergence of item C2: the ordering and the scatter with particle number (the lead: ratio 1.9 to 3.1 against 2 for noise), the agreement of the mass growth between M/8 and M/16 (4.4e-4), M/4 outside the regime; the exterior constraint norms against particle number; (5) the finding that the step in one criterion of the earlier run ES-FL came from horizon excision ending at four times the initial radius (FK and ES-FL identical to 219 M); (6) the open point the lead marks TO VERIFY: FK and FN4 remove about 30 per cent of their dust up to 0.4 to 0.7 M of proper time before the exact crossing after about 235 M (FN4 from 170 M). With your reference decide what you can: is dust removed early, or is the comparison clock off, and does it touch the growth criterion? A prediction before each recomputation, the outcome after it. Per claim: reproduced (to how many digits), not reproduced, or not checkable and why; predictions and criteria that failed as written are stated as failed (the null test at M/4, the part D3 at N/4 and for the early removals of FF4, the cost predictions, the others the package lists). Figures you look at. Write stage/G2/VERIFIER.md; only after it is written, a last section that compares with the lead's verdicts.
